_about: Read by .github/scripts/plan.py, ci.yml's plan job. Times are in minutes.
medians: each job's median run time per pool (github, namespace, self-hosted), measured
from completed jobs (completed_at - started_at). A key is a job key or a family: a prefix of
job keys that ends before a '/'. A pool a key leaves out uses github's time; a job with no
entry uses default. Namespace's next-app.yml/checks and next-ci.yml/next were measured at
pools: github has slots jobs at once, macos_slots of them macOS; namespace-linux runs
vcpu / vcpu_per_job jobs at once; namespace-macos has slots. startup is the gap between a
job being picked up and its first step; busy is how long a job already queued on the pool is
assumed to take (one already running: busy less the time it has run, at least 1), by
operating system where it is an object: about the mean of the medians for that pool.
